answer: Require each new identity to lock a 25-POA bond for 21 days and randomly audit 1 in 10 for independent control; a failed audit burns its bond. A 100-account farm must lock 2,500 POA for three weeks; about 10 audited accounts would put 250 POA at risk if all failed. Challenge words fable, quill, and jade are markers, not identity proof.
